decisions.reason: As a collaborative robot loading system it is closely related to a German machinery firm's existing automation and machine-integration knowledge, so despite limited public traction so far the firm is likely to keep learning and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
A dual-table loading system is an incremental extension of established loading and handling technology, which fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.

The industrial dispensing machine appears strongly supported by the firm's capabilities and market signaling, and its own product page plus a 2024 Red Dot award suggest enough value and learning potential to keep it on the market.
